(tsa)༄༅/ /rje bla ma nyid kyi thugs dam du gser gyi brgyad stong pa bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus sogs/dkar chag 'ga' zhig bzhugs so/ /oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/la

tei:div.tei:p: (tsa)༄༅// rje bla ma nyid kyi thugs dam du gser gyi brgyad stong pa bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus sogs/ dkar chag 'ga' zhig bzhugs so// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ lha dbang dbang po'i dgra dang pad dkar mig /mig gsum pas mchod mchod sbyin brgya pa'i lha// lha yi lha khyod khyod rang nyid dang mtshungs// mtshungs med kun mkhyen mkhyen brtse'i dbang por 'dud// chos rnams kun dang de mkhyen byed po nyid// snga phyi min par chabs cig sangs rgyas pa'i// thabs tshul 'gran med shes rab pha rol phyin// thog mar 'chad mkhas bu ram shing pa des// bzhi stong gis lhag brgyad khri'i sgo chen po// gzhan dang gzhan gyi dang por yod min pa'i// nges ster gling gzhi'i cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum// thog mar bshad pas chos 'di'i ya mtshan shes// chos tshul gzhan dang gzhan pa gang gang gsung tshe de des gdul bya'i rigs can so so gang gang gis ni chos tshul de dang de'i gdan bshom shes rab pha rol phyin 'di 'chad tshe gzhan gyis ma yin thub dbang nyid kyis seng ge'i khri chen mngon par bshams// khri chen de la mnyam par bzhag pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi ni cho 'phrul can des sa chen rnam pa drug g.yos mdzad pa mi mjed zhing 'di yi ni mi khom brgyad po ma lus zad mdzad 'jam dpal gyi ni zhing bzang padma can bzhin byin gyis brlabs// gsung gang rjes su bstan pa'i cho 'phrul gyis ni phyogs bcur gaṅgā'i klung rdul dang mtshungs 'jig rten khams kun zil gyis gnon byed kha dog sna tshogs 'bar ba'i 'od phreng bye ba phrag khrig brgya stong drug cu po ni ba spu'i khung bu re las rnam par spros// thugs gang byin gyis brlabs pa'i cho 'phrul gyis ni phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba gang dang gang zhig rang rang mdzad pa so sor nges pa'i khengs pa btang nas de de'i 'khor gyi rgyal sras ma lus pa ni 'dab stong padmo'i skyes chen dang bcas der lhags gus pas phyag byas so// 'jig rten khams kun rgyal ba'i ring srel gyis// byur bur gtams la zab cing rgya che ba'i// mchod pas mchod las yum 'di'i tshig gcig tsam// yi ger bris pa'i bsod nams lhag par gsungs// chos kun 'dzin dang bsdud mdzad kun dga' bos// lung gzhan brjed kyang de tsam skyon mi 'tshal// yum 'di'i tshig gcig skyur ba'i nyes lci zhes// lan gsum bar du thub pas rjes gtad mdzad// chos 'phags slob mar bcas pa'i sngon byung gi

/gtam gyi sbyor ba rgyas par thos pa na// chos 'di'i ngo mtshar blo la gshin zhing ljen// tshad mas drangs shing nges pa 'di shes byos// sgrub pa'i mchod pas rgyal ba dges mdzad pa// kun gyi nang nas yum 'di 'bri 'chang klog /rab dang phul gyur mchod pa bla med ces// thub pas gsungs phyir yum 'di bsngags par 'os// chos 'di'i lung tsam gang na bzhugs gyur pa// der ni 'dod pa'i dbang phyug 'khor bcas kyi// me tog mda' lnga ring du 'bor byed pa// sbrul gdug pa dang rtsi ma gi bzhin no// gzhan 'phrul dbang byed bdag pos me tog gzhu// rgyal dang de sras rnams la ring nas 'gengs// mchod sbyin brgya pas chos 'di dran tsam na// yan lag bzhi tshang bdud dpung dbyings su zhi// srung byed gzhan la rag las yod min pa'i// thub chen ston pa'ang brgya byin gyis bsrung na// bdud kyi gnas chen gzhom la spro 'di kun// ma bskul bar yang chos 'di ci mi bsrung*// 'jig rten mes pos snod bcud ma lus pa// ci dgar bskrun zhes 'chad de gsal bar brdzun// rten 'brel stong nyid zab mo'i byed po yis// sgyu ma'i rnam rol sna tshogs sprul 'di bden// stong nyid margad 'khyil ba'i chu gter du// gzhan gzhung rlabs phreng gya gyus ma dkrugs shing*// rang gzhung nges don nor bus ma bslus pa'i// rgyal yum rgya mtsho'i dpal gang deng 'dir 'khrungs// lce brgya ldan pa'i chu 'dzin gyis blangs shing*// 'phrin las klung brgya rtag par 'bab mkhas kyang*// nyan bshad lung rtogs char chen phebs pa na// chos kyi mtsho chen nam yang zad mi mnga'// byams pas gzigs pa'i nges don mi 'dor zhing*// klu sgrub gzhung gi rigs pas ma btang ba'i// rgyal yum shing rta 'dren pa'i kha lo pa// gzhan dang mi mnyam mchog ldan legs pa'i blo// chos 'dir mi phyed dad pa'i gdung shugs dang*// sbyin po rnams kyi tshogs mang rdzogs bya'i phyir// 'gyur mdzad gzhan las khyad 'phags rngog lo yis// legs bsgyur yum 'di'i bdag rkyen 'dir grub pa// ma rnams srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba dang*// sher phyin bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang*// rgyal po chos bzhin mdzad dang rgyal khams kun// dar zhing rgyas dang dge ba'i bkra shis spyon// 'di yi rgyu sbyor bdag rkyen lag len pa// bla ma'i zhabs thog tshul bzhin sgrub pa yi// nye gnas sangs rgyas seng ges bgyis pa dang*// dag byed blo bzang kun dga'i mtshan can dang*// dbon gyur dkon mchog rgyal mtshan mched kyis mdzad// gser 'dul lto dkar mkhas pa'i grags thob pa// rigs bzang lang tsho'i dpal 'dzin 'di zhes dang*// dkyus yig mkhas pa 'di dang 'di rnams kyis// dad dang gus dang dge la spro ba yi// bsam pas bsgrubs 'di byang chub chen por bsngo// rnga chen gyi lo/

sa gas nya ba'i yar tshes bco lnga la/ zhes pa 'di ni dpal glang ri thang gi gzhal med khang du grub pa'o// ༈ //brgyad stong pa dang phal chen bzhengs pa'i lo rgyus so// ༄// swasti pra dza bhyeḥ bde 'byung gtsug gi zla gzhon lang tsho yis// dal bur btegs pa'i zhabs sen 'od dmar can// srid gsum nyin mor byed pa'i dpal mnga' ba// thub chen kun gyi bla mas 'dir skyongs shig /thub rnams dges pa'i bzhin mdzes me tog gis// nye bar sim pa'i rgyal yum sgeg 'chang ma// rtag tu rgyal ba'i sras kyi khur 'dzin pa// gang khyod 'gro kun mun pa'i lam las bsrungs// sbrang rtsi'i dgra bos ma myangs ro brgya pa// rnam dpyod hub kyis 'thungs nas gzhan phan gyi// dpag bsam yongs 'du'i phrag par nyer mtshon pa// thub bstan 'dzin pa'i tshogs rnams zhabs brtan shig /rin chen dkon mchog gsum po'i phrin las kyis// des bskrun phya mkhar mthon po'i pho brang du// sa chen skyong mdzad brgyud mar byung pa ni// chos srid 'phan dar rgyas pa'i yul gyi rgyan// gang der yum gcig dpal 'dzom bzang mo yi// bsod nams nor 'dzin dpal mo'i phang pa nas// gang 'khrugs glegs bam lhun po'i ltad mo ni// rab mnyam dbang sngon brtsegs pa'i ngos 'jam la// yid 'ong btso ma'i gser gyi thig phreng can// ngo mtshar chos kyi rnga dbyangs gsar pa 'dis// brgya byin snying gi chu gter nam yang 'dzin// gang 'di bris dang klog dang mchod pa yis// dge legs dag byed dpal mo'i rgyun gang gis// mi dbang chos mdzad gang de'i dgongs pa ni// mkha' dang mnyam pa gang zhing rdzogs gyur cig /de nas mi bdag nam mkha'i rgyal mtshan dpal// sa bdag rgyal po sras yum mched dang bcas// dus kyi sgra gcan gdug pa'i kha rlangs dang*// pha rol mi bsrun phrag dog drag po yi// khyab 'jug lag pas nam yang mi sgrib par// bsod nams rta brgyas drangs pa'i khrir 'khod nas// phrin las 'od stong phyogs brgyar gsal ba dang*// mnga' 'bangs mtsho bzhin gong nas gong 'phel shog

/rgyal yum snying po stong phrag brgya pa dang*// shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod phal po che// mthing shog ngos la gtso chen 'od 'bar ba// gang 'dis bstan pa'i snying po gsung gi rten// lha rdzas rin chen sna tshogs nyer bsags nas// bzo rigs mkhas pa las kun thams cad pas// dge bar bskrun pa'i bkod legs mchod phreng can// gang 'dis rgyal ba'i thugs kyi bang mdzod bzung*// de nas legs bshad chos kyi sgo brgya pa// ngo mtshar gaṇḍe'i sgra dbyangs brgya phrag gis// blo gsal rgya mtsho rtag par bsdud mkhas pa'i// gtsug lag khang chen bstan pa'i bang mdzod 'dzin// de ltar grub pa'i rnam dkar lam gsum pas// chos kun dga' bzhi'i thugs kyi rdo rje 'chang*// gang de'i dgongs pa gong nas gong dag tu// yongs rdzogs chos kyi nyi ma 'char gyur cig /mi dbang don yod rgyal por mtshan gsol ba// gang gi thugs rgyud dri mas ma gos par// rnam dkar tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs byas nas// chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phangs la reg shog /de nas blo gros chos kyi rgyal mtshan yang*// dpal ldan phrin las bzang pos nyer mtshon nas// sa gsum 'gro ba'i dpal du zhabs brtan cing*// rnam dkar phrin las rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog /rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin// zag med dga' bzhi'i dpal gyur dam pa'i chos// phrin las bzang po'i dpal 'dzin rgyal ba'i sras// dkon mchog gsum dngos de yi bkra shis shog/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༄༅// rgyal khri dpon pas dkon brtsegs bzhengs pa'i dkar chag oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ gang sku sku gsum ngo bo rdo rje 'dzin// de gsung gsung gi dbang phyug 'jam pa'i dbyangs// khyod thugs thugs rje'i mnga' bdag spyan ras gzigs// dngos grub grub pa mchog rnams 'dir stsol cig /'od dpag med pa'i rnam 'phrul a ti sha /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag bshes gnyen ston pa'i mtshan// skal ldan shing rta nyid 'khrungs sangs rgyas dbon// brgyud par bcas la deng 'dir skyabs su mchi// phan bde'i 'byung gnas thub bstan rin po che// ring du gnas shing nam yang ma nyams pa// kha ba can ljongs yid bzhin mtsho chen 'dir// thub pa'i zhal skyin jo shāka rnam gnyis bzhugs// de yis byin brlabs dbu ru byang gi phyogs// btsan phyug 'phan dar 'dzom pa'i yul gru ni// rgya mtsho ji bzhin 'byor pa'i tshogs kyis gang*// nyi ma bzhin du bstan pa'i 'od dkar 'char// skye bo phal cher dad pa'i zhing sa la// dge legs lo thog bskrun mkhas nor 'dzin bzhin// yul gyi ljongs 'dir sngon gyi dus shig na// pha rol dregs pas nam yang mi gnon pa// srid zhi'i dbang phyug rgya ma si tu'i mtshan// don grub rgyal mtshan zhes bya kun las mtho// de sras rdo rje tshe brtan ye shes mchog

/rigs brgyud mchog tu grags pa nam mkha'i mtshan// de sras gsum pa chos dang srid kyi ni// gzhung lugs mtha' dag rdzogs par chub mdzad nas// gzhan gyis mi 'phrogs dad brtson mkhyen pa yis// dag pa'i zhing du bde bar gshegs gyur pa// bsod nams rgyal mchog rab brtan dpal bzang po'i// thugs kyi dgongs pa zab mo bskang phyir du// dkon mchog ri dbang brtsegs pa'i lhun po 'di// pha rol dregs pa'i ri bos mi gnon zhing*// tshu rol nang gi rol mtsho ma 'khrugs par// lhag bsam nor 'dzin sgeg mo'i 'phang par 'khrungs// sngon dus srid pa'i byed pos lha yul nas// dag byed tshangs pa'i bu mo lam gsum pa// 'phrog byed ral pa'i khur du ma sim par// mes po'i dri ma sbyong byed sa stengs phab// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag las// mchog gyur gsung gi mdzad pa ya mtshan can// dag byed khrus kyi dpal mo'i rgyun gang gis// yab dang mes po'i tshogs kyi nyes kun bkrus// phyis 'byon brgyud pa'i chu bo mi 'chad cing*// 'byor pa'i mtsho chen rtag tu gang ba dang*// bstan jus lhun po gzhan las cher mtho ba// dkon mchog rin chen brtsegs pa'i khor yug can// de bskrun byed po'i bsod nams dpag bsam shing*// mi dbang sa bdag nam mkha'i mdzod bzung nas// tshe dang bsod nams ri dbang ltar brtan pa// nam yang mkha' ltar yangs pa'i mnga' ris su// mngon par mtho dang nges par legs thob pa// legs ldan mgon pos rjes bzung srid pa'i dpal// chos kyi 'byor pas nges par rgyud phyug pa// mched dang dpal mor bcas pa'i 'chi med rgyun// mi zad gter gyi bum pa nyid gyur cig /de ltar de bskrun byed pa'i yi ge pa// mkhas pa'i brgyud 'dzin 'di dang 'di la sogs// bcu phrag gsum dang 'od 'bar glegs shing pa// 'di zhes bya dang dag byed sbyangs pa can// sde snod 'dzin pa 'di dang 'di dag go

/rigs rnams kun gyi bdag po rdo rje 'dzin// nam yang bslu med rin chen dkon mchog gsum// bstan pa bsrung mdzad dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// kun gyi bkra shis gang yod gnas 'dir byon// //maṅga laṃ// ༈ //rgyam byang sems mas thugs dam glegs bam bzhengs pa'i dkar chag/ ༄// oṃ swasti siddhaṃ/ 'jig rten mes po'i gtsug rgyan zla ba la// gang gi zhabs sen dmar po'i 'od ris can// mig stong ldan pa'i snying la bde ster ba// mtshungs med ston pa de la mgos phyag 'tshal// lan gcig thos na rna ba'i dpal bskyed cing*// mang por bsams na snying gi gdung ba sel// yun du bsgom na 'chi med gnas stsol ba'i// dam pa'i chos khyod kun nas bsngags par 'os// nye dbang dbang po'i dgra dang pad dkar mig /mig gsum pas mchod mchod sbyin brgya pa'i lha// lha mchog de yum yum mchog pha rol phyin// phyin drug kun las khyad 'phags 'phags ma'i gsung*// rgyal ba'i sku gdung ring bsrel snying po can// phra rab rdul gyi grangs snyed bskrun pa des// yum gyur pha rol phyin ma'i tshig 'bru gcig /bris mchod bsod nams char mi phod ces gsungs// sngon tshe 'jig rten skyabs gcig ston pa la// 'dod pa'i dbang phyug tshogs kyis tho brtsams tshe// brgya byin dbang pos yum 'di bsams tsam gyis// me tog gzhu can dpung las rnam par rgyal// yul phyogs gang na rtsi ma gi yod pa'i// dri tsam gyis kyang sbrul gdug phyir ldog byed// yum 'di'i cha shas kyis kyang bdud dpung dang*// dus min 'chi sogs gzhan gyis glags mi lta// de phyir yum 'di glegs bam la bris nas// sbyin dang mchod dang klog par gang byed pa// de la 'jig rten skyong ba rnam bzhi yis// nye bar dgongs nas nyes kun sel ba dang*// grub pa mchog rnams bde blag stsol lo zhes// rigs par gsungs la mi phyed dad thob nas// 'phags ma'i mchod sbyin thob pa des bsams pa// de las byung ba'i rnam dkar bgrang yas kyis// bsod nams rgyal mchog rab brtan dpal bzang po'i// thugs rgyud sbyangs shing yon tan tshogs kyis gang*// kun dga'i chos kyi 'tsho ba rang nyid kyang*// yum mchog pha rol phyin ma nyid gyur cig

/gang sku sku lnga'i bdag nyid rdo rje 'chang*// de gsung gsung gi dbang phyug bdag med ma// nyid thugs thugs rje'i bdag nyid kun dga'i mtshan// bkra shis shis brjod mdzad pa'i dge legs spyon// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang dam pa'i chos nyid dang*// mchog tshogs 'dus pa'i byin brlabs gang yod dang*// dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bkra shis spyon// //maṅga laṃ// //bha wantu// /shu bhaṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
